question: In reference to the Census of India, what is the full form of CMMS?
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Census Management and Monitoring System'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CMMS **is a new initiative to monitor and manage all the ongoing census operations in real time with the use of a web portal.

 
 
• CMMS falls under the** Information Technology Act 2000.**
 
• Indian government wants to rely heavily on Census Management and Monitoring System for the **census 2021-22**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Census** means **collecting information and recording the details of the members of the population.**
 
• In India, the **census is conducted every 10 years**. It is known as the **Decennial Census.**
 
• Census plays a major role in planning, analyzing, and implementing of actions for the government. As of 2021, the **census in India has been conducted 16 times.**
 
• There are** 34 regions of operations** where the census is conducted, it includes **all the states and the union territories of India. **
 
• The** talking points** of every census are** total population, population growth rate, sex ratio, and literacy rate.**
